learning_outcomes.text: Demonstrate the ability to analyze and synthesize
Demonstrate skills for planning, organization, and strategy
Acquire the ability to solve problems effectively
Express oneself correctly in Spanish, both orally and in writing
Possess solid knowledge that allows oral and written communication in a foreign language, preferably English
Possess knowledge of Information and Communication Technologies (ICT)
Acquire skills related to the use of computer programs for calculation, data analysis, and processing within their field of application
Develop the ability to transmit information, ideas, problems, and solutions to both specialized and non-specialized audiences
Information search and management skill
Possess the ability to make decisions
Information Literacy
Develop critical reasoning
Develop interpersonal skills
Develop the ability to work in a team
Ability to work in an international context
Ability to work in an interdisciplinary team
Acquire commitment to ethics and social responsibility
Appreciation of diversity and multiculturalism
Ability to apply knowledge to practice
Acquire the capacity for autonomous learning and concern for knowledge and continuous training
Develop the ability to adapt to new situations
Ability to generate new ideas (creativity)
Demonstrate leadership ability
Knowledge of cultures and customs of other countries
Ability to work autonomously
Show initiative and entrepreneurial spirit
Motivation for quality and continuous improvement
Achievement motivation
Become aware of issues related to the environment
All Specific Disciplinary Competencies (ED) and Specific Professional Competencies (EP) included in the Verified Report are also part of the learning outcomes for the Final Degree Project.

teaching_methods: Realization of the Final Degree Project
assessment_rules: The evaluation involves assessing the Final Degree Project report and its public exposition and defense before a tribunal. Weights are 65% for scientific and technical knowledge, 20% for presentation and exposition, and 15% for personal skills. The same weighting applies to both the first and second convocations. An annex reflecting on sustainability aspects (600-800 words) must be included as part of the work.
